notes.notes:
Version 1.0.1.0[color=yellow] Official version [/color]

August 16, 2025

[color=lightgreen] Repair and Optimization [/color]
1. The text format for displaying the quantity of items has been optimized.
2. Fixed the issue where the cooldown time abnormally decreased during high-speed multi-enemy battles such as Beast Tide.
3. Fixed the issue where the enemy's image was displayed incorrectly in the mind wandering mode.
4. The list of characters to be selected for reincarnation and tribulation has added a function to filter "reincarnable characters". (Level meets character)
5. Fixed the issue where the number of enemy killing tasks in secret realms or dungeons was not counted.
6. The World tree has been upgraded to allow for a rapid input of one level of material each time you right-click with the mouse.

notes.title: Official version launched FAQ
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support! The official version 1.0.0.0 of game has been updated!

[color=yellow] I have compiled the player issues encountered after the official version update for your reference: [/color]

[color=lightgreen]1. What are the contents updated in the official version? [/color]
Q: This update mainly covers the Westward Journey plane, the Abyssal Beast Tide gameplay, the World Tree Holy Beast gameplay, the 4th and 5th level classes, the achievement system, and the Holy level equipment, etc
You can browse through the previous released news or enter the game and click on the lower left corner to view the update log.

[color=lightgreen]2. How to claim the redemption code for the internal test collector's character Zhao Yun? [/color]
Q: Zhao Yun's redemption code has been made public. After entering the archive, press esc and click on 6666 to claim it. (Invalid if already claimed)

[color=lightgreen]3. How can I claim the activation of the supporter pack in the game after purchasing it? [/color]
Q: Enter the main game screen and check that the confirmation green is highlighted at the lower left corner, indicating that the supporter pack has been activated.
Enter the game again, click on the municipal center of the main plane and select "Claim Gift" to activate it.

[color=lightgreen]4. Will there be any updates after the official version of the game? [/color]
Q: The official version is just a stage, not the end. The game will be updated with more content and DLCS for expanded gameplay.

[color=lightgreen]5. Why aren't Steam achievements activated automatically? [/color]
Q: Enter the Celestial Treasure Record - Record the Divine Journey, click to activate the achievement, claim the corresponding Star Soul rewards, and at the same time activate the steam achievement.

[color=lightgreen]6. Some players are unable to enter the game? [/color]
Q. Situation 1: The word "nwjs" is displayed and access cannot be made: Clean up the C drive to leave sufficient cache space
Situation 2: Unable to start, the steam button keeps showing "Cancel" : Right-click on the game installation directory and directly run game.exe
In case of any other situations, you can post on the steam community or enter QQ and I will assist in solving them

[color=yellow] I will correct the content of this update based on everyone's feedback and suggestions! [/color]
[color=yellow] If you like "The Record of Treasures in the Heavens", please give it a steam review! Thank you for your support! [/color]

notes.title: Important update notice
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! I'm the author,  First of all, I wish you a happy New Year!
Thank you for your support of "Multiverse loot Hunter"! After fighting for dozens of days and nights, this major update is finally about to be completed!
Considering the need to add more content, as well as various factors such as testing and commissioning, Chinese New Year reunion, and the upcoming Hang-up Gaming Festival (starting February 4),
Finally [color=yellow] decided to make this major update on February 1st [/color]!

[color=lightgreen] (ps: haven't started the player boldly rest assured to buy it, without this update, the previous content is at least enough for you to play more than 400 hours) [/color]

Here is a preview of the content of this update:
The update has five main components:
1.[color=yellow] Five large copies [/color] : Burning Chibi, Jingju Royal Tomb, Lanruo Mysterious Shadow, Ninja War, Original Holy Land
2.[color=yellow] Endless Tower [/color] : Endless challenge to obtain endless star souls.
3.[color=yellow] Rebirth system [/color] : Unlocks a new level cap and unlocks a new chart.
4.[color=yellow] installation and other quenching function [/color] : directly upgrade the level of equipment, no longer frequently change, a set of like can be used in the end.
5.[color=yellow] Other additions [/color] : 16 stronger characters, 40 deities (Level 7) weapon deputies, 24 new armor ornament sets, and new enemies

New play：

[color=yellow] Finally and sincerely explain: [/color]
Original plan: Just do a simple reincarnation function, click the reincarnation button after the level, bang, the reincarnation is completed.
This is a very quick system to complete. However, my OCD attack, feel that this is not fun, I hope to have more content, more experience!
Therefore, out of the plan, [color=yellow] added a large replica gameplay to the reincarnation system that was not originally planned. [/color]
(You can go back to my version update plan, and this set of large copy gameplay is really not in the original plan)

The huge increase in content represents a huge increase in workload, so the update [/color] is delayed, but I believe you can understand.
My goal is to make a game that is fun to play and rich in content, and I don't like it to be dry and boring.
Some test friends suggested that since it is an additional content, you can make dlc to sell money, and no longer make free dlc to pretend to sell praise to players.
I don't think it's necessary. My game doesn't have a definite plan, and it will bring new inspiration and add new content at any time because of your feedback.
I'm willing to add it as soon as the game gets better.
I'll do dlc too, and I'll want to make money. If one day I do release dlc, you can support me a lot!
Again, I'm more interested in spiritual gains, and I'm glad that so many of my friends enjoy playing my games.
Still please continue to support, if you like , give him a steam praise! This is my source of motivation ~!
